newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - May 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - May 26.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Police continue investigation on kidnap and murder of Pai Hsiao-yen, daughter of actress Pai Ping-ping
Whitney Houston stages concert in Taipei.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Taiwan, Hong Kong activists to sail to disputed East China Sea archipelago on 15 vessels.
National Assembly continues discussion on amending Constitution.
LIBERTY TIMES - President Lee Teng-hui says he will make Vice President and Premier Lien Chan "a little busier".
Foreign Minister John Chang visits Senegal.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Motherboard giant Asustek receives overwhelming responses in its overseas fund raising.
Taiwan to consider lifting ban on real estate investment by foreign funds.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Communist China to investigate potential tax evasion by Taiwan investors on mainland.
Government to encourage investment by offering low-interest loans.
